movie.title: Nothing Between Us
movie.overview: Living in Mexico City, Guillermo and Mechi, in Buenos Aires, are separated by over 4,000 miles and their marriages, both having structured family lives. Working for the same multinational food manufacturer they meet by chance at a corporate offsite. The attraction between them proves immediate and irresistible. The sudden spark makes them face their own desires and changes them in deeper ways than they thought possible.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When two married corporate colleagues from different countries hit it off at an offsite event, their instant attraction forces them to reevaluate their structured lives and unspoken desires.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Guillermo from Mexico City and Mechi from Buenos Aires both live comfortable, structured lives within their respective marriages. Separated by over 4,000 miles, their paths cross unexpectedly when they attend the same corporate offsite for their multinational food company. An irresistible, immediate spark flares between them, sparking a transformative connection that challenges everything they thought they knew about themselves. As they navigate this sudden romantic pull, both are forced to confront their true desires and the realities of their daily lives.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Guillermo resides in the vibrant metropolis of Mexico City, where he balances a quiet domestic life with his demanding position at a multinational food company. Thousands of miles away in Buenos Aires, Mechi leads a remarkably similar existence, maintaining a structured marriage and working for the same corporation. Neither anticipates that a routine corporate offsite will disrupt the stability they have carefully built over the years. When a chance meeting brings them face-to-face, the chemistry between them is immediate, magnetic, and completely unexpected. What begins as light workplace banter rapidly deepens into a powerful emotional and romantic bond that neither can ignore. Separated by geographic distance and existing marital vows, they find themselves caught between safety and passionate self-discovery. The intense connection serves as a mirror, exposing hidden dissatisfaction and long-buried desires in both of their lives. Over the course of their time together, Guillermo and Mechi must confront the emotional consequences of their mutual spark. Ultimately, the encounter leaves a lasting mark, forever altering their self-perceptions and the paths they choose to follow.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Living in different corners of Latin America—Guillermo in Mexico City and Mechi in Buenos Aires—two professionals navigate the rhythms of long-held marriages and established corporate routines. Both work for the same global food manufacturer, but their lives are separated by distance, culture, and domestic boundaries. A chance encounter occurs when both are sent to a joint corporate offsite, bringing them into the same space for the first time. The immediate, irresistible pull between them sets off a chain reaction of self-discovery, humor, and emotional tension. As Guillermo and Mechi explore this unexpected connection, 'Nothing Between Us' offers a nuanced, heartwarming, and dramatic look at modern romance, duty, and the choices that define our happiness.

story_structure.climax: The emotional tension reaches a boiling point as the reality of their connection demands a defining choice between maintaining their secure status quo or committing to the internal transformation sparked by their relationship.
story_structure.conflict: A chance encounter at a corporate offsite triggers an immediate and irresistible mutual attraction, forcing both to confront the tension between their professional and domestic commitments and their sudden personal desires.
story_structure.resolution: Both characters undergo profound personal shifts, coming to terms with their true desires and accepting how this unexpected encounter has permanently altered the trajectory of their lives.
story_structure.introduction: Guillermo in Mexico City and Mechi in Buenos Aires lead established, structured family lives within their respective marriages, physically separated by thousands of miles while working for the same multinational company.
story_structure.risingAction: As the unexpected connection deepens, Guillermo and Mechi navigate the emotional and logistically daunting challenges of a long-distance bond, forcing each to question the stability and authenticity of their existing lives.
